patch.sql:
select
    c.customer_key,
    c.customer_name,
    c.market_segment,
    c.account_balance,
    n.nation_name,
    r.region_name
from {{ ref('stg_customers') }} c
left join {{ ref('stg_nations') }} n on c.nation_key = n.nation_key
left join {{ ref('stg_regions') }} r on n.region_key = r.region_key
patch.explanation: Fixed the join logic in dim_customers. The original join incorrectly matched c.customer_key to n.nation_key, dropping most customers and causing downstream null region_name values. Updated to join on the correct foreign key c.nation_key = n.nation_key and changed the region join to a left join to retain all customers even if a region is missing. This preserves column names/types and ensures all customers appear in the dimension, addressing the null spike in fct_orders.region_name.
